name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $73,700 on 11 Nov, 15% below its high and 12% lower on the month; no stablecoin de-peg found
state: Bitcoin was near $73,700 early on 11 Nov, 14.9% below its 52-week high of $86,600 and 12.3% lower over a month, inside the 25% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The worst day of the past five sessions was a 2.0% fall. This run found no stablecoin de-peg or top-10 exchange failure as of 11 Nov, so Normal is kept while the decline continues.
for_you: Crypto prices have fallen steadily over the past month. Holders face larger swings than in most other assets.
rubric_hit: BTC drawdown 13.9% below the 25% Watch line
why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
